name: bones-special-restore
description: Oracle, Minetown, Juiblex, and Valley bones loads preserve rooms, occupants, and destination bounds.

segments.name: oracle-save
segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:wizard,role:Wizard,race:human,gender=male,align:neutral,playmode:debug
OPTIONS=!autopickup,!tutorial,!tips,pettype:none,!debug_mongen,pauper,nudist,!autoquiver
OPTIONS=suppress_alert:3.4.3
OPTIONS=symset:DECgraphics
OPTIONS=!confirm
OPTIONS=menustyle:traditional
OPTIONS=paranoid_confirmation:none
OPTIONS=disclose:-i -a -v -g -c -o
OPTIONS=!tombstone
